spec.studio_prompt: A modern 160x200 cm double bed with a 125 cm tall winged headboard upholstered in charcoal grey velvet (#3e393d) featuring vertical channel tufting. The low-profile matching grey velvet frame (#3e393d) holds a deep mattress dressed in smooth white cotton sheets and two rectangular pillows (#dcdae1).
